crash_handler_risk: Godot installs its own handler that prints a backtrace. On current master (not the 4.3 source), the SEH variant ends with return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH ("Pass the exception to the OS") and the signal variant has no abort or _exit. No source states whether Event 1000 is written for official builds. Docs list --disable-crash-handler ("Disable crash handler when supported by the platform code"); launch with it to avoid depending on the handler.

risk_to_pc.reason: Crash during file import inside a throwaway project folder.

notes: akien-mga could not reproduce on Linux and suspected a Windows-specific (possibly MinGW) problem, so this one is well suited to a Windows test PC. Fix is PR #104347, which replaced jpgd.h with libjpeg-turbo.
